description:
EXIT and ERR traps within one run, and in the child commands the shell starts.

Each run is one script, so its EXIT trap runs when the script ends or exits, as with `bash -c`.
Child commands (`find -exec`, `xargs`, `sh -c`) stand for new processes: they start without the
caller's EXIT and ERR traps and run their own. In the oracle image `sh` is BusyBox ash.

cases.name: traps: EXIT runs when the script ends
cases.script: trap 'echo bye' EXIT; echo hi; echo there

cases.name: traps: EXIT runs on exit and sees its status
cases.script: trap 'echo bye $?' EXIT; echo hi; exit 3

cases.name: traps: EXIT sees the final variable values
traps: exit inside the EXIT trap sets the status
traps: EXIT in a subshell
cases.script: ( trap 'echo sub' EXIT; echo in ); echo out

cases.name: traps: EXIT replaced and cleared
cases.script: trap 'echo one' EXIT; trap 'echo two' EXIT; trap - EXIT; echo end

cases.name: traps: find -exec children skip the caller's EXIT trap
cases.script: trap 'echo bye' EXIT; mkdir -p /tmp/tx && touch /tmp/tx/a /tmp/tx/b; find /tmp/tx -type f -exec true \; ; echo done

cases.name: traps: xargs children skip the caller's EXIT trap
cases.script: trap 'echo bye' EXIT; printf 'a\nb\n' | xargs -n 1 true; echo done

cases.name: traps: sh -c runs its own EXIT trap
cases.script: sh -c 'trap "echo inner" EXIT; echo body'; echo outer

cases.name: traps: ERR is not inherited by -exec children
cases.script: trap 'echo err' ERR; find /tmp -maxdepth 0 -exec false \; ; echo done

cases.name: traps: ERR runs for a failing command
cases.script: trap 'echo err $?' ERR; false; echo after

cases.name: traps: ERR is not inherited by functions without errtrace
cases.script: trap 'echo err' ERR; f() { false; echo in-f; }; f; set -E; f

cases.name: traps: DEBUG runs before each command
cases.script: trap 'echo "debug: $BASH_COMMAND"' DEBUG; x=1; echo $x; trap - DEBUG; echo quiet

cases.name: traps: RETURN runs when a function returns
cases.script: f() { trap 'echo returning' RETURN; echo body; }; f; echo after

cases.name: traps: trap -p and -l
cases.script: trap 'echo e' EXIT; trap -p EXIT; trap - EXIT; trap -p EXIT; echo status=$?

cases.name: traps: trap on an invalid signal
cases.script: trap 'echo x' NOSUCH; echo status=$?; trap -- 'echo y' 99; echo status=$?

cases.name: traps: EXIT trap in a function runs at script end
cases.script: f() { trap 'echo exiting' EXIT; }; f; echo body

cases.name: traps: exit status inside EXIT trap
